# Provenance

* `inputs.txt`: generated by `tests/adm_orekit_oracle.rs` (deterministic, synthetic values).
* `kshana/`: written by Kshana (`src/adm.rs`) from those inputs.
* `orekit/`: written by Orekit 13.1.8 (Apache-2.0) through `xval/adm-orekit/AdmOracle.java`
  from the same inputs.
* `outputs/orekit_reads_kshana.txt`: what Orekit 13.1.8 parsed from `kshana/`, dumped by the
  same driver.

Orekit is used only as a separately run oracle; none of its code is in Kshana.
